Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: cryptographic protocols | ID: 93589

Statement

For a normal image G acting on a topological space X, the orbit space X/G inherits a natural quotient topology.

Step 2. The analytic functional \(\Phi_{01330012}\) on the Bergman space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01330012}\| \leq C_01330012\) by the analytic embedding theorem.

Step 3. Applying the continuous interpolation theorem to \(U_{01330013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the rational convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01330011 \cdot C_01330012 \cdot C_01330013\).
